milestones.exit_criteria: A trivial task runs end-to-end, traced, checkpointed; kill-then-resume produces no duplicate commit/PR; reducer-purity + idempotency property tests pass.
milestones.note: State backbone + build-order items 1-8 (state/, schemas/ base subset, durability/, proxy/, execution/, gates/, governance/+monitors/, context/, graph/skeleton.py) already implemented & tested. Baseline: ruff clean, mypy foundry clean, 247 pass/1 skip, coverage 82%.

milestones.exit_criteria: From a one-line request, produce a small working app passing its own + hidden tests, opened as a PR a human merges with minimal edits. Distinct Spec/Build/Test gates wired at phase boundaries; criterion-traceable tests; flake quarantine; content-addressed artifacts; PR-equivalent emit via the outbox (no real GitHub in tests). Phase-1 smoke: foundry/cli.py runs the compiled graph end-to-end with a mock/test model provider + stub worker substrate without live API keys.

milestones.phase: Phase 1.5 — Decision gate: powered A/B + role ablation
milestones.exit_criteria: Variance/base-rate pilot (blocker, runs first); frozen pre-registration + decision table; powered A/B harness (3 arms, oracle-scored primary, ITT) + role ablation — built and exercised against local/synthetic task fixtures (not a funded live study). Decision: structure beats baseline by pre-registered margin at <= cost -> Proceed; null at MDE -> Hard KILL/redesign; {USD-null, token-positive} -> bounded overhead-redesign.
milestones.note: Decomposed by T-M1_5-PLAN into T-M15-01..T-M15-11 (all DECISION-GATE only; the confirmatory A/B + full scorecard/optimization are Phase 6 and NOT pulled in). New module: foundry/evaluation/ (hypothesis, task_fixtures, harness, pilot, power, preregistration, ab_runner, decision_table, ablation, scorecard) exercised on SYNTHETIC fixtures via the existing MockTransport/StubAdapter doubles + cli.run + build_factory_graph, binding to the EXISTING global_records alpha look-ledger (eval_set_identity, decision_id). Honest dry-run of the methodology, not real evidence. Each evaluation/*.py = single owner; collision hazards (factory_graph/supervisor/state/schemas/pyproject) untouched.

milestones.exit_criteria: A known-vulnerable change is caught; Design/Release require recorded sign-off; re-verification is change-proportional; rework loops terminate within caps and HITL volume is measured.
milestones.note: Decomposed by T-M2-PLAN into T-M2-01..T-M2-11. WIRE+EXTEND, don't rebuild: the gate IMPLs (gates/security.py, audit.py, supply_chain.py, e2e.py), the TwoZoneGateRunner (+ its reuse_key for §1f), reviewer_critic, the supervisor convergence loop (route_after_gates / fix_attempts_since_all_green / max_fix_attempts), HumanLiaison (self-judge deferred_log), the WORM hash chain (durability/outbox.append_audit/verify_audit_chain), and the existing security/governance schemas all EXIST. Phase 2 adds: the Security/Audit/Supply-chain AGENT nodes (agents/security/, triage-only), an assurance gate-wiring helper + subgraph wiring those impls in at the assurance boundary (a known-vulnerable change is CAUGHT), change-risk tiering in triage (governance/tiering.py, scales depth+HITL never integrity), dependency-scoped re-verification (graph/reverification.py off runner.reuse_key), the reviewer-driven evaluator-optimizer rework loop (reuses the existing convergence bound), HITL Design/Release sign-off + evidence pack appended to WORM (governance/sign_off.py + durability/evidence_pack.py, self-judge stamp recorded), and a Gated-mode emit (factory_graph.py). Collision hazards (factory_state.py / reducers.py / supervisor.py / factory_graph.py / a given schema module) = single owner per wave, serialized via dependencies.

milestones.exit_criteria: An operator can diagnose a stuck run; a store outage pauses (not corrupts) in-flight runs and recovers; concurrent runs don't starve each other; HITL backlog is bounded and alerted.

A malicious-test / forged-results / forged-verdict / fork-divergence attempt cannot reach production; trusted-component outage degrades to paused, not wedged. (Dev-grade roots per implementation-plan §0.3.)

A regulated request makes Autonomous/auto-approve unreachable and binds approver-of-record; an ML request keys verdicts on state_sha with a class-3 gate + compute budget; a UI request forces visual HITL over a rendered bundle — all without core changes to add the next pack.

Scorecard published and stable; confirmatory A/B reproduces the Phase-1.5 result (estimation/replication only); optimization Pareto-improves >=1 headline metric with no regression in escaped-defects, cost, wall-clock, or policy compliance; product-feedback + maintenance/provenance loop.

tasks.title: Power calc + (n,k) constrained allocation off the pilot

Power is task-level (paired cluster-bootstrap unit = task), never n*k as independent draws.
